evidence: Cic. Div. 2.74: cōnsulēs magistrātū sē abdicāvērunt (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The formal word for giving up an office before its term: magistrātū, cōnsulātū, dictātūrā sē abdicāre; also tūtēlā sē abdicāre (Cic. Att. 6.1.4). Without sē, abdicāre is to disown or reject.

terms.gloss: lay down, give up (a post, a command)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short gives dēpōnere magistrātum as the synonym of sē abdicāre. With mūnus or officium it serves for leaving a job today.

phrases.latin: Mūnus suum dēposuit et nunc rūrī vīvit.
phrases.english: He resigned his post and now lives in the country.

sources: Lewis & Short: abdico · Lewis & Short: depono
